Heap-buffer-overflow in libxml2 parser: xmlCopyCharMultiByte (parserInternals.c), invoked from xmlParseCommentComplex in parser.c, can write one byte past the end of a dynamically allocated comment buffer while parsing XML comments. This out-of-bounds write can corrupt the heap and lead to crashes or potential code execution when processing crafted input.
